description: This file contains a comprehensive suite of GoogleTest unit tests for various components related to DeviceInfo and Store modules within the project. It tests getter and setter functions for device parameters, interactions with external files and system states, as well as network request handling and request validation. The tests encompass various scenarios including normal operation, error states like missing files, and invalid input handling.
